name: @sojaner/telex
description: Telegram relay plugin and MCP server for local AI agents

scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'';if(fs.existsSync('src')&&!ua.startsWith('pnpm')){console.error('\\nThis repo uses pnpm. Run: corepack enable && pnpm install\\n');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-dist/test/*.test.js
